'''"Tunnel" Toli''' was a [[human]] who as a [[Youngling|child]] served as a member of the [[White Worms]] gang on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. He earned his keep in the gang by slipping into utility wiring trunks and patching into power and data grids in order to keep the gang connected to the rest of the planet. In [[13 BBY]], he was present when the [[scrumrat]] [[Han Solo|Han]] escaped from Proxima in the [[Den of the White Worms]].

==Biography==
Toli was [[human]] known as "Tunnel Toli" who as a child served as a [[scrumrat]] in the [[White Worms]] gang of [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. He earned his keep in the gang by slipping into wiring trunks and patching into power and data grids so that the gang was connected to the rest of the planet.<ref name="SoloOG" />

In the [[Standard year|year]] [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' that take place on [[Corellia]] to six years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Corellia in ''Solo'' must take place in [[13 BBY]].</ref> Toli was present in the den when the fellow scrumrat [[Han Solo|Han]] was brought before [[Lady]] [[Proxima]], leader of the gang. Han, who had returned from a trade with no goods for Proxima, used a rock to break a shutter behind the gang leader and bathe her in light, which burned her skin. Using the distraction, Han then pushed through the other scrumrats and escaped.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Toli had tan skin, [[Color|black]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==Equipment==
Toli wore a gray [[Salt|brine]]-stained [[Clothing|shirt]] with a red light-filter headband. He carried valuable wires with him.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toli first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
